post.description: Current originating user session and current owner/membership are required on every retry. A running Job becomes cancelling with held funds and resource occupancy unchanged. Completed delivery is never undone. Queue-only cancellation may settle zero before execution; independent cleanup/settlement remain required for started work. Source content and new-spend grants are not needed to stop the original Job.

post.description: Current original user only. Request body is the exact original SubmitTextJob. Key scope is user/owner/Invocation. A prevented receipt fences future acceptance for this user and Invocation, with no invented Job or refund; an existing Job is cancelled through its normal lifecycle and may remain cancelling/pending. Every replay rechecks current authority.

post.description: Quote measured source duration in development credit units. The named grant, reviewed Worker, requester and price version must still be eligible. A quote does not reserve funds.
